[Story]
Mrs. Liu, the owner of the mall store, hopes that Mr. Zhang, the owner of the bookstore next door, turns down the volume at night so that her baby sleeps peacefully.

[Question]
How does Mrs. Liu persuade Mr. Zhang?

[Candidate Answers]
A. For example, she recommends using headphones or installing soundproofing equipment.
B. She describes how pleasant and conducive to business the mall environment becomes if the noise is under control.
C. She directly makes a request, explaining that her baby cannot sleep due to the noise.
D. She suggests that when he turns down the volume at night, he can turn it up a little during the day.
